purpose: Close the final reusable-protocol coverage gap using current product-specific ADP WorkForce Suite integration documentation. Spec evidence only; no credentials or writes.

patch.evidenceNote: Current ADP WorkForce Suite product documentation explicitly describes RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs and file-based CSV/XML interfaces, plus integrations with HCM/ERP systems. This closes protocol discovery only; no sandbox or customer tenant authentication was performed.
